connectorUiConfig.title: Prancer Data Connector
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The Prancer Data Connector provides the capability to ingest [Prancer CSPM](https://docs.prancer.io/web/CSPM/) and [PAC](https://docs.prancer.io/web/PAC/introduction/) findings into Microsoft Sentinel using Microsoft Sentinel's Codeless Connector Platform (CCP). This solution deploys the Data Collection Endpoint (DCE), Data Collection Rule (DCR), and the `PrancerFindings_CL` custom table. Prancer's backend then pushes findings directly into your workspace using the [Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/logs-ingestion-api-overview) against the deployed DCR. Refer to the [Prancer Documentation](https://docs.prancer.io/web) for more information.

dataTypes.name: PrancerFindings_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
PrancerFindings_CL
            | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
            | where isnotempty(Time)

value:
PrancerFindings_CL
            | summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
            | project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(30d)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions on the workspace are required.

customs.name: Monitoring Metrics Publisher
customs.description: Prancer's ingestion identity (the Microsoft Entra ID application registration created for your tenant during onboarding) must be assigned the **Monitoring Metrics Publisher** role, scoped to the Data Collection Rule (DCR) deployed by this solution. This grants least-privilege permission to push findings via the Logs Ingestion API and nothing more.

parameters.content: **Step 1 - Deploy the ingestion resources.** Deploying this solution creates the Data Collection Endpoint (DCE), the Data Collection Rule (DCR), and the `PrancerFindings_CL` custom table in your workspace. No manual table or DCR creation is required.

**Step 2 - Grant Prancer's identity ingestion rights.** Assign Prancer's Microsoft Entra ID application registration the **Monitoring Metrics Publisher** role, scoped to the DCR deployed above. This is the least-privilege role required to push findings via the Logs Ingestion API.

**Step 3 - Configure Prancer.** In the Prancer portal, provide the DCE **ingestion endpoint URI** and the DCR **immutable ID** (both shown on the deployed resources after this solution is installed). Prancer's backend then begins pushing scan findings into `PrancerFindings_CL` via the Logs Ingestion API.
